# Version 4.147.0
> **Skia m147 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts and animated WebP encoding. It adds color font palettes, sampling-aware surface draws, memory-backed stream access, Linux Bionic assets, and 64-bit Tizen support. This preview line also raises the WebAssembly floor to .NET 8 and contains breaking API and runtime changes that require migration.

## Breaking Changes

- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo APIs move to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. Update references to the new `GR` casing; the obsolete `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` shim remains for migration, but no longer implements `IEquatable` or its former equality operators. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKFont without a typeface now uses the empty typeface** — `SKFont()` and `SKFont(null)` now produce an empty typeface rather than resolving the platform default. Pass `SKTypeface.Default` when text measurement or rendering requires the default system typeface. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside the native range** — `SKStream.Move(long)` is obsolete and now uses a checked conversion to the native 32-bit offset, so out-of-range values throw `OverflowException` instead of being silently truncated. Use an in-range offset and migrate away from the long overload. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The Tizen arm and x86 native assets are no longer built or packaged. Move Tizen deployments to the supported `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` runtime identifiers. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8** — Native WebAssembly assets for the older Emscripten versions associated with .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed, and those targets now produce a build error. Upgrade Blazor or Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Assembly version moves to 4.147.0.0** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks that depend on the previous assembly version.

## Engine

- **Bundled Skia advances to milestone m147** — The engine moves from m119 through m132 and m133 to m147, bringing codec orientation improvements, HDR and wide-gamut work, newer color-aware filters, CICP color spaces, and accumulated raster and filter fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Bundled image, font and compression libraries refreshed** — libpng moves to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — `SKTypeface`, `SKFontArguments`, and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design coordinates, named instances, palette selection, and per-color overrides. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Sampling-aware surface draws** — New `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` overloads accept `SKSamplingOptions`, restoring control over filtering when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — `SKWebpEncoder` and `SKWebpEncoderFrame` can encode a timed sequence of pixmaps as a single animated WebP. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Memory-backed streams expose SKData** — `SKStream.GetData()` returns a ref-counted `SKData` when the native stream can provide its contents cheaply, avoiding a copy for memory streams. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Document, GPU and mask-filter wrappers completed** — Adds `SKDocument.CreateXps` options, per-resource `GRContext.Flush` overloads, `SKMaskFilter.CreateShader`, and the correctly cased `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` API. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **HarfBuzz colors map correctly to SkiaSharp** — The new `HBColor` value type represents HarfBuzz BGRA values correctly, with conversions to and from `SKColor` and `SKColorF`. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))

## Bug Fixes

- **Default typeface startup is more robust** — Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font manager, preventing Android API 36 startup crashes and allowing NanoServer to use an empty font manager where system font APIs are unavailable. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744), [#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))
- **Variable-font Span APIs and glyph checks corrected** — Undersized variation buffers now follow native all-or-nothing semantics correctly, and `SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs` no longer recurses until a `StackOverflowException`. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Android SKGLView survives tab and page navigation** — A reattached `SKGLView` now initializes its GL thread with the current dimensions, so returning to a MAUI tab or page no longer leaves the view blank. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Negative SKStream offsets retain their sign** — The native stream move callback now uses an explicit 32-bit integer, preventing negative offsets from being zero-extended on LP64 platforms. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKPath finalization no longer races SKPathBuilder** — Disposal skips pending builder flushes once finalization begins, preventing a crash when the builder is collected before its owning path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic native assets** — Dedicated `linux-bionic` packages now provide x64 and arm64 binaries for Linux environments that use Android's Bionic libc. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen moves to 64-bit architectures** — Native packages add `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` assets, while the m147 transition removes the obsolete 32-bit arm and x86 builds. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Apple target frameworks align with base workloads** — .NET 10 libraries target Apple platform version 26.0 rather than 26.2, avoiding an unnecessary Xcode 26.2 requirement for consumers. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WebAssembly raises its runtime floor** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native WebAssembly assets retain .NET 8 and later Emscripten variants and report a clear build error for .NET 6 or .NET 7. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces `HBColor` for correct color conversion, and provides Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Raises WebAssembly native assets to .NET 8 and moves `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo`-facing APIs to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`, while adding `HBColor`, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, and shader mask filters. Refreshes libjpeg-turbo, FreeType, and zlib, and fixes default font-manager startup on NanoServer. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Moves bundled Skia from m119 through m147, adding HDR/CICP color support, variable and color-font APIs, sampling-aware surface draws, managed default-typeface resolution, and corrected `SKStream` offsets.
